planning_notes: The request for 5 targets is fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct core concepts from the available pool of 9. To ensure non-redundancy and medium difficulty, each target is assigned a unique pedagogical facet that moves beyond simple definition recall. The selection covers the structural definition (Class-based architecture), the mathematical mechanism (Loss calculation), the optimization process (Optimizer), the data flow (Forward Propagation), and the training procedure (Training Loop). This provides a comprehensive assessment of the neural network pipeline from structure to execution.
